subject: Request: comprehensive prompt-output & runtime-log sanitization — closure checklist
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@medsigo.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lee <sara.lee@medsigo.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 16:23:00 -0800
Subject: Request: comprehensive prompt-output & runtime-log sanitization — closure checklist

Rachel —

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. We’re ready to move forward with a full sanitization request for our Medsigo tenant (tenant-id: MED-00421). Scope we need covered:
- All prompt inputs and generated outputs associated with our tenant (last 36 months).
- Runtime logs and request traces (including KV cache artifacts) for the same period.
- Any derivative indices or embeddings created from prompt/output material.

We need a clear execution timeline (start window, expected completion, maintenance windows), the evidence package you’ll deliver (manifests, signed attestations), and a designated contact at Redwood who will shepherd the run. We also expect chain-of-custody info for the artifacts you remove.

Our compliance team would like: an initial confirmation within 24 hours, a pre-execution checklist, and a post-execution packet suitable for our auditors (PDF + machine-readable logs). If you need a formal signed request, let me know and I’ll route that asap.

Regards,
Alex Chen
Head of Platform Security — Medsigo
alex.chen@medsigo.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: MEDSIGO_sanitization_request_form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: comprehensive prompt-output & runtime-log sanitization — closure checklist

Alex —

Thanks — we got this. Internal team (cc’d) will own execution. Quick notes:
- We can start within the 72-hour window after formal sign-off.
- Standard evidence package includes a signed manifest (PDF), a compressed log bundle (jsonl), and a checksum manifest for removed objects.
- We’ll provide a DocuSign for a scoped removal authorization if you prefer a signature on record.

Priyom, Marissa — can you confirm the runbook we’ll use for MED-00421 and outline any customer-impact windows? Vivek, looping you for a quick compliance check on the evidence artifacts and wording for the DocuSign.

Alex — expect an internal pre-exec checklist from us by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Rachel Kim

rachel@redwood.com

Rachel Kim

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@medsigo.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: comprehensive prompt-output & runtime-log sanitization — closure checklist

Team / Alex —

Working plan (summarized):
1) Scope confirmation (by tenant-id MED-00421) — confirm token ranges and feature flags used by Medsigo.
2) Snapshot & preserve: take immediate live snapshot for forensic reproducibility; snapshot stored encrypted and accessible only to Compliance.
3) KV cache eviction & derivative sweep: evict tenant-specific KV entries, run index/embedding scan for derivatives and delete matching objects.
4) Runtime log reduction: redact PII in streaming traces and remove raw request payloads older than retention threshold — we will delete full raw traces for the requested 36-month window.
5) Downstream caches: issue invalidation for CDN/edge caches if any tenant-side caches exist.
6) Manifest & checksums: generate sanitization_manifest_v1.2.pdf and kv_sweep_log_20261219.jsonl (machine-readable).
7) Attestation & signature: produce a signed closure packet and provide DocuSign acknowledgment.

Schedule:
- Pre-exec checklist & customer confirmation: 2026-12-19 11:00 PT (tomorrow morning).
- Execution window: 2026-12-20 02:00–06:00 PT (low traffic window) — 4 hours expected; contingency +2 hours.
- Evidence delivery: 2026-12-20 09:00 PT (manifest + logs + checksum + short ops runbook).

Impact: We do not anticipate service downtime for customer traffic; heavy requests during the window may see slightly elevated latency for short KV eviction periods. Any write-heavy jobs running at execution will be briefly rate-limited.

Attachments we will deliver: sanitization_manifest_v1.2.pdf, kv_sweep_log_20261219.jsonl.

Action items for Alex: confirm final scope (36 months ok?), and confirm you want DocuSign for acceptance.

Priyom Das
Operations Lead — Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com

---
Attachment stubs: sanitization_manifest_v1.2.pdf (application/pdf); kv_sweep_log_20261219.jsonl (application/jsonl)

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@medsigo.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Sara Lee <sara.lee@medsigo.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: comprehensive prompt-output & runtime-log sanitization — closure checklist

Rachel / Priyom —

Thanks for the clear plan. Two quick clarifications from compliance:
1) Please include any system traces (e.g., scheduler/task metadata) older than 90 days that reference tenant request-ids — these are part of our audit scope.
2) For the manifest, can you include a small mapping file (csv) that lists object-id -> removal-reason (deleted/expired/derivative) so our auditors can cross-check?

DocuSign: yes, please send the scoped removal authorization. We’ll sign within 24 hours.

Appreciate the low-impact window. Confirmed: 36 months scope and include the extra trace sweep.

Alex

From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@medsigo.com>, Sara Lee <sara.lee@medsigo.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: comprehensive prompt-output & runtime-log sanitization — closure checklist

Alex / Sara —

Work completed and evidence delivered. Summary:
- Execution window: 2026-12-20 02:05–05:10 PT. Full sweep completed within estimated time.
- Scope: All prompt inputs/outputs (36 months), runtime traces older than 90 days, KV cache entries, and derivative indices were processed.
- Artifacts delivered: sanitization_manifest_v1.2.pdf (signed), kv_sweep_log_20261219.jsonl (machine-readable), object_mapping_MED-00421.csv (object-id -> removal-reason), and docusign_ack_MEDSIGO_2391.pdf (signed authorization).

Key notes:
- No service downtime observed. Transient latency spikes (under 200ms additional p90) during eviction windows.
- Forensics snapshot taken and retained under restricted access for 90 days (standard for emergency restore) — if you require longer custody we can escalate via legal.
- Checksum validation: all removed objects have checksums included in the manifest.

Delivery links: https://redwood.app/artifacts/medsigo/RD-2391/sanitization_manifest_v1.2.pdf
https://redwood.app/artifacts/medsigo/RD-2391/kv_sweep_log_20261219.jsonl

If everything looks good on your side we’ll mark RD-2391 as closed in our ticketing system and push the evidence packet to your compliance mailbox.

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the signature.

Best,
Rachel Kim
